summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiaries entered into lender joinder agreements to increase a revolving credit facility by $250M to $1.55B, with an uncommitted accordion up to $2.0B and maturity on April 3, 2028. The filing also declares routine quarterly distributions across seven share classes ranging from $0.2648 to $0.3300 per share, payable on July 27, 2026. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, activist campaign, or other special situation event is present. This is a routine current report on a credit facility amendment and dividend declaration.
